newsitem.title: USA: Celeron seen high bidder on Elk Hills oil.
newsitem.headline: Celeron seen high bidder on Elk Hills oil.

text.p: Celeron Trading and Transportation was the highest bidder in the U.S. government's offering of 15,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude from the Elk Hills Naval Petroleum Reserve here, according to traders.
The company bid $22.078 a barrel for 4,165 bpd of crude from the 18G zone here, based on a West Texas Intermediate crude index. Bids were for a two-month delivery period starting December 1.

Other bidders, in descending order, were as follows: Texaco Trading and Transportation at $22.040 for 2,500 bpd, Bravo Energy Trading at $22.021 for 3,000 bpd, Texaco Refining at $21.980 for 5,001 bpd. EOTT Energy Partners asked for 1,000 bpd but received 334 at $21.951.
